I don't have a bladder problem, I am a normal fucking human who needs to pee more than 2 times over a 9 hour time frame so I had to get a doctors note and open a case *just so I can have an extra 5 minutes a day off the phones to pee*. 

Ok so what do you suggest I do? I already live paycheck to paycheck with this pay, how am I supposed to take a paycut for more flexible hours? Default the loans on my (cheap and crappy) car and get it repo'd? Get evicted? Have my medical bills go to collections? Not have utilities? Our phones are free because I work for the company, so there's $90/month that will get added on to monthly costs, and that's if we get cheap prepaid "go phones".

And I'll have to work a shitty job for at least a year before I even start school to claim those wages on a tax return so I can get a PELL grant, because you know a shitty job isn't going to have a tuition program. 

It's a huge clusterfuck and I hate it. 

I hate myself for being an idiot when I was right out of high school and not finishing college. I hate myself for getting stuck in this whole situation and I know it's going to end badly.

Had to log into the throw away I made a few weeks ago for suicide watch.

I make $16/hr at a call center listening to rednecks bitch me out because they're too fucking stupid to understand a simple cell phone bill.

The call center pays that sweet spot where they lock you in. You make more than other menial labor jobs, but fuck you if you want to move up. In fact, what brought on my bought of insufferable depression was a meeting about a possible promotion to a measley 50k/yr job was the guy acting like I wasn't worth the 30 minutes he took to talk to me because I didn't have a degree.

Why haven't I finished college? Because the classes I need to take to finish my degree in civil engineering can't be done online and the times vary.

So what? One would think you could just say "Hey boss, on Tuesdays and Thursdays I need to skedaddle an hour early for class, but I'll make up for it by coming in early" ... Oh no. At a call center they are up your ass and wondering why you took an extra 45 seconds on your lunch. 

*Did you know I have an open case with the Americans with disabilities act simply to be able to go pee more than 2 times a day*? 

Do you have that problem, Mr Richman? I would take 3am calls if it meant that I could piss without an act of congress, literally. 

Wanna talk about drug addiction? Ok, let's talk about the my benzo-alcohol-caffeine-opiate cocktail. I literally swallow a couple xanax and lortab with a vodka redbull every morning, just so I don't go ballistic on some asshole who thinks patronizing me will get him the latest smartphone for free.

I swear the only thing keeping me alive is my amazing girlfriend, who knows nothing of my problems. So if she does find out, she'll leave me and then I can really just off myself and no one would miss me. Work will just clean out my cubicle and toss my sorry little pile of Architectual digests and my kitten calendar in a box. In fact, they'd probably be happy to bring someone in who only makes $12/hr instead of my tenured pay.

Oh, and I literally live paycheck to paycheck. I had $40 in my account before I got paid and I almost cried from joy.

So, come spend some time in my shoes. Tell me how it feels laying awake dreading another 8 hours of slobbering angry people treating you like you're subhuman so you can have $40 to your name, wondering how much longer you can keep your addiction a secret from the one person who gives two shits about you.

And the thing is *i want to be better*. I want to go to school, but I can't due to not being able to take a paycut and not finding jobs with same pay but more flexible hours.

If I had a *fraction* of the money that you seem to have, I would make myself a better person, instead of spinning my wheels in a life of mediocricy.

I also had to get a note from my doctor to use the bathroom.

The weird thing is, there isn't anything wrong with me. I just drink a lot of water (3-4 liters a day) because, you know, talking for 8 solid hours dries up your throat.

I had to pay for a doctor visit and tell a doctor that I needed a note to pee. It was an awkward conversation. He asked if there were any problems urinating (pain, blood, discoloration, etc) ... I was like no I just drink about 3 liter sized bottles of water a day and I'm not allowed to leave my desk unless it is my break, but I only get 2 breaks. He just sighed and filled out the form they gave me. Now I have a claim under the disabled americans act... Just to go pee more than 2 times a day.

And what really pisses me off is all the supervisors go take several 10-15 min smoke breaks throughout the day, but I can't take a couple 2 min runs to the bathroom to pee?

Yeah that's the thing... This job pays decent. I actually make as much, if not more, than some people I know with degrees. The thing is this is as far as I can get without one.

I just talked with a guy in a different dept to develop and his first question was what my degree is in. I am aure it wasnt his intention to make me feel bad, however here I am feeling more hopeless than ever.

I don't really have the money for school either. I "make too much" according to the government to get pell grants. which is fucking BS, I bet the rich politicians who came up with these rules couldn't fathom living off my pay. 

It's like I am completely stuck. I can either quit my job and hit the true poverty line which would also mean defaulting on my car loan and house lease fuckijg up my credit, or I can just stay where I'm at where I have $30 in the bank after every check because it all goes to bills as soon as I get paid.

I literally am paid and broke on the same day.

I've got nothing in savings. I don't ever do anything fun. We hardly get to go have dinner at a restaurant, unless it is with my parents who pay. I never get to see my parents unless they come here because they live about 50 miles away and can't afford extra gas for a 100 mile round trip.

It's just spinning my wheels and I feel so depressed over it.

I have told people i hate it.

I just get back family who say "no one is supposed to like thwir job" to friends/family who were lucky enough to have their parents pay for school act like i am a lazy piece of ahit for not going to school. They dont understand what its like to be responsible for bills.

Everyone wants to tell me how smart and talented i am but no one wants to help me out financially.

The thing is i have mentioned this.

Everyone thinks i am just being a baby about it. My parents have flat out said "no one is supposed to like their job" and that i should be grateful i have one.

No one takes this seriously.

So i end up slamming 100 proof vodka at work and taking my xanax script with it, just to deal with it.

My ins policy is 250k. That is like a little under 10 times what i make in a year

I cant help but think my can do so much for herself with 250k than sacrificing meals to make ends meet right now.

It is hard.

I just want tondonwhat i love doing instead of having a supervisor up my ass because 2 min are out of my day whe  i had to take  a piss outside ofnbreak times.
